# AI PR Review Rules: windowstead

Detailed repository-specific review guidance is now cataloged as trusted-base skills:
- [.agents/skills/windowstead-gameplay-review/SKILL.md](../.agents/skills/windowstead-gameplay-review/SKILL.md) for gameplay, save compatibility, worker behavior, economy, UI orientation, and Godot validation.
- [.agents/skills/windowstead-workflow-security/SKILL.md](../.agents/skills/windowstead-workflow-security/SKILL.md) for workflow configuration, GitHub App credentials, model secrets, token scope, and least privilege.

The native reviewer catalogs .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md when repository-skills: "true" is enabled. Read the relevant skill for the changed area; the repository's product constraints and actual workflow configuration remain authoritative.
